title: Add chat transcript and feedback data plane for fine-tuning
description: Create durable chat transcript + thumbs feedback capture with retention/redaction controls so MemorySmith can produce high-quality supervised and preference datasets from real usage.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from critical pre-implementation review. This is a prerequisite for any meaningful SFT/DPO/ORPO pipeline because current chat history is effectively client-local and non-durable.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented first data-plane slice: Training options contract, transcript writer service, chat turn/session id propagation, chat feedback SQLite store, and chat feedback API endpoints. Added regression tests for transcript capture and feedback upsert/replace behavior. Remaining scope includes retention/redaction hardening and operator UX for feedback actions.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Added transcript redaction and retention controls (`TranscriptRedactionEnabled`, `TranscriptRetentionDays`) with default-safe behavior and admin settings coverage. Transcript writer now masks common secret patterns and cleans stale JSONL files best-effort. Remaining work is user-facing feedback UX and exporter integration.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Wired thumbs-up/thumbs-down controls into chat UI for assistant turns and persisted per-turn rating via `IChatFeedbackStore.UpsertAsync`, including local session state hydration (`ChatTurnState.FeedbackRating`) so selections survive refresh. Remaining scope is exporter/bridge plumbing for dataset generation and lifecycle tooling.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: 2026-07-10 triage: Moved from InProgress to Backlog. Core transcript capture, redaction, retention, and feedback UI are all implemented and tested. Remaining work (exporter/bridge, lifecycle tooling) has been dormant since May 28. Will be revisited when training pipeline integration is actively resourced. See architectural-stability-cleanup-sprint-20260710.md.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Integrated first exporter path through harness bridge execution. Run `sprint3-ft-20260528` produced `Data/Training/exports/sprint3-ft-20260528.sft.jsonl` and benchmark/status artifacts, confirming transcript/feedback foundation can feed training datasets end-to-end.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Audit synthesis distinction: transcript retention/redaction and feedback persistence are already represented here, but the redacted audit identifies a separate identity-integrity gap for unauthenticated sessions sharing one principal. A focused session-scoped feedback task is being created.
